description: Engram gives your AI assistant long-term memory. It stores your conversations verbatim and makes them searchable by meaning, so context, decisions, and preferences carry across sessions instead of being forgotten. Ask it to remember something and recall it days or weeks later. Your memory is private to your account and works across the MCP clients you connect.
